item.title: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
item.description: The blast in Shanxi province constitutes the country's worst mining disaster in 16 years.

item.title: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
item.description: Ukraine says it struck Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in a Moscow-occupied region.

item.title: French mum and partner held until trial after sons abandoned by road in Portugal
item.description: The couple, who allegedly left the woman's sons on a roadside in southern Portugal, will remain in custody.

item.title: Senegal's president sacks PM and former ally after months-long feud
item.description: Bassirou Diomaye Faye also dissolved the government, creating uncertainty amid a debt crisis in the country.

item.title: F1 great Prost 'injured as masked gang raid home'
item.description: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Alain Prost was injured when a masked gang raided his home near Geneva, Swiss media reports.

item.title: DR Congo players told to isolate before World Cup
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo's World Cup squad must isolate for 21 days before they can enter the US because of the Ebola outbreak.

item.title: Tulsi Gabbard to resign as US national intelligence director
item.description: Gabbard who has been largely out of public view during recent US operations says she is leaving due to her husband's illness.

item.title: Race for French presidency sees ex-PM Philippe as early favourite to beat populists
item.description: Latest polls suggest the centre-right figure is the only candidate who can defeat Marine Le Pen or Jean-Luc Mélenchon.

item.title: One dead and dozens of firefighters injured in Staten Island shipyard explosion
item.description: More than 30 people, including firefighters, were hurt in the incident, which was described as "a complex, fast-developing emergency situation".

item.title: Bodies of Italian divers did not have optimal equipment, says rescuer
item.description: Images from a cave where the four Italians were found reveal the difficulty that rescuers had in recovering their bodies.
